verdict.rationale: Agora's pricing page documents a recurring free usage allowance, "First 1 million messages free every month", which could cover development and early testing of messaging features. The pack shows no free allowance for the core voice, video, live-streaming or conversational-AI products, so it only partly covers a founder's development needs. Missing for 10: a documented free tier or free minutes for RTC voice/video and AI agents, a statement that the free allowance covers development and testing usage, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the free tier.

support.subject: As a founder, a free tier or free usage allowance covers development and early testing

citations.quote: First 1 million messages free every month
